title: Proverbs As A Window On Collective Prescriptions
abstract: arXiv:2611.34832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proverbs, as repositories of traditional wisdom, have informed human reasoning for millennia. Yet the collective prescriptions they encode have remained largely unquantified. We introduce a computational framework to analyze nearly 50,000 English-language proverbs. Using large language models, validated against human judgments, we map the topical landscape of proverbs, assess their prescriptive power, and quantify their recommendations on key dimensions of human judgment and behavior. We find that most proverbs are prescriptive, offering guidance in domains under individual control, such as preparation and prudent action, whereas proverbs about uncontrollable circumstances, such as fate and mortality, tend to describe rather than prescribe. translated_title: 谚语：窥探集体规约的一扇窗口
translated_abstract: 谚语作为传统智慧的宝库，数千年来一直为人类推理提供指引。然而，它们所承载的集体规约在很大程度上尚未被量化。我们提出了一个计算框架来分析近50,000条英语谚语。利用经过人类判断验证的大语言模型，我们绘制了谚语的主题分布图，评估了其规约力量，并量化了它们在人类判断与行为关键维度上的建议。我们发现，大多数谚语都具有规约性，在个人可控的领域（如做好准备与审慎行动）提供指导，而关于不可控境况（如命运与死亡）的谚语则倾向于描述而非规约。当规约性谚语采取一致的立场时，它们更倾向于谨慎而非冒险、长期结果而非短期结果、诚实而非欺骗、善良而非恶意，并表现出中等程度的倾向……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于大语言模型（经人类判断验证）的计算框架，首次对近5万条英语谚语所承载的集体规约进行量化分析，发现多数谚语在个人可控领域具有规约性，并普遍倡导谨慎、长期主义、诚实与善良等价值观。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an LLM-based computational framework, validated against human judgments, to analyze nearly 50,000 English proverbs, quantifying the collective prescriptions they encode and showing that prescriptive proverbs predominantly favor caution, long-term outcomes, honesty, and kindness.
